ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the recent Medicaid fraud investigation in Minnesota and the impact of the funding hold on the state's Medicaid program
ideas.angle: Follow the money trail to uncover the extent of the fraud
questions: What is the extent of the Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How will the funding hold affect the state's Medicaid program?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and shed light on the impact of the funding hold on vulnerable populations. I will be tracking this story closely and conducting further research to determine the best approach.
